summary: Complaints centre on the disputed road proposals for Chhaprauli, Doghat and Tikri nagar panchayats and on cane dues at two district mills; the positives could not be sourced this round and are flagged as inference.

positives.basis: Inference: an Aaj Tak Baghpat ground report (26 Sep 2026) is the only lead for this, but the page returned HTTP 403 and was not read, so no claim from it is verified. District-level, not AC-specific

positives.basis: Inference: no source found for this season in this round. Included only to reach five positives; a field check should confirm or replace it. Not AC-specific

negatives.english: Allegedly, road proposals for Chhaprauli, Doghat and Tikri were not approved
negatives.hindi: छपरौली, दोघट और टीकरी के सड़क प्रस्ताव मंजूर न होने का आरोप है
negatives.basis: Amar Ujala (30 Sep 2026): the article says Chhaprauli, Doghat and Tikri nagar panchayats fall in RLD MLA Ajay Kumar's Chhaprauli constituency and none of his CC road proposals were approved; the MLA questions why they were not sent to government; the SDM Khekra (acting project officer Surabhi Sharma) says all proposals received were approved and sent to government. Allegation, not settled. AC membership confirmed by the Wikipedia Chhaprauli Assembly constituency page (accessed 2026-10-13), which lists Chhaprauli NP, Doghat NP and Tikri NP of Baraut tehsil

negatives.english: Cane dues pending at Kinauni and Bhainsana mills, notices issued to pay
negatives.hindi: किनौनी और भैंसाना मिल पर गन्ने का बकाया है, भुगतान का नोटिस मिला
negatives.basis: Amar Ujala (12 Oct 2026): Kinauni mill has dues of Rs 20 crore and Bhainsana mill Rs 9 crore; District Cane Officer Asharfi Lal issued notices to both to pay within one week. The same article also says all three Baghpat mills have paid in full, which contradicts its own dues figures; that sentence is not used. District-level; AC membership of these mills unconfirmed, so not counted as AC-specific

negatives.english: Groundwater is falling in Baghpat and there are problems with water quality
negatives.hindi: बागपत में भूजल गिर रहा है, पानी की गुणवत्ता में भी दिक्कत
negatives.basis: Wikipedia Bagpat district page: the Central Ground Water Board has reported declining groundwater levels and quality issues in Bagpat district, singling out Binauli, Pilana and Khekra blocks. District-level; Binauli block is not the same as the AC; AC membership unconfirmed. CGWB report itself not opened

negatives.english: A Chhaprauli to Haridwar bus was announced, but there is no news of it starting
negatives.hindi: छपरौली से हरिद्वार बस का ऐलान हुआ, पर चलने की खबर नहीं
negatives.basis: Amar Ujala (17 Jun 2025): the article says a Chhaprauli to Haridwar bus via Doghat would run at 6:30 am, that the facility had not been available until then, and that an official said it would begin soon. No start date given; no report of its start found in later searches. Verify on the ground. Route starts in Chhaprauli town, inside the AC

negatives.english: A night fire in a Chhaprauli town warehouse, anti-social elements suspected
negatives.hindi: छपरौली कस्बे में रात को गोदाम में आग, असामाजिक तत्वों पर शक है
negatives.basis: Amar Ujala (19 May 2025): cardboard warehouse fire in Mohalla Qureshiyan, Chhaprauli town, late on Sunday night (18 May 2025); cardboard worth over Rs 50,000 burnt; owner suspected anti-social elements. Cause not confirmed. Single incident, not a broad complaint

round2.changes: Aaj Tak 26 Sep 2026 ground report could not be opened (HTTP 403): its sources removed from positives 1-4 and those items flagged as inference. Positive 5 (all three mills paid in full) removed as contradicted by the same 12 Oct article and by its dues figures. Cane-payment positive dropped. Negative 1 basis now quotes the 30 Sep article and confirms NP membership via the Wikipedia AC page. Negative 2 keeps the dues notice and drops the contradictory 'paid in full' claim. Negative 3 Hindi shortened to 11 words. Negative 4 reworded to 'announced, start not confirmed' because the 2025 article cannot show the current status. Re-ranked: road dispute 1, cane dues 2, groundwater 3, bus 4, fire 5. Verified this round: Wikipedia AC list row 50, Wikipedia Chhaprauli AC extent, Bagpat district Wikipedia, both Amar Ujala 2026 articles, bus and fire articles. Searches for 2026 Chhaprauli-specific news returned nothing usable; an MP-meets-CM Amar Ujala article (1 May 2026) names only Malakpur mill and was not used

notes: AC identity confirmed: Wikipedia list row 50 (Chhaprauli, Bagpat, None) and the Chhaprauli Assembly constituency page (Baraut tehsil; Chhaprauli, Doghat and Tikri NPs). Spelling: Bagpat on Wikipedia, Baghpat in official usage. Hindi name from press usage. Positives: all five are inference because the only source for them (Aaj Tak, 26 Sep 2026, https://www.aajtak.in/uttar-pradesh/story/baghpat-sugarcane-farmers-ground-report-electricity-fertilizer-payment-ntc-apdy-utrath-rptc-2653619-2026-09-26) returned HTTP 403 and could not be read; re-open it on a retry or find an outlet copy before citing. Cane contradiction resolved with the latest dated source (12 Oct 2026): dues of Rs 20 crore (Kinauni) and Rs 9 crore (Bhainsana) with notices; the 'paid in full' sentence in that article contradicts its own figures and is not used. AC membership of Kinauni and Bhainsana mills is unconfirmed. Coverage gap: no 2026 Chhaprauli-specific report on water, roads, power or jobs was found. The 21-road Rs 30 crore plan (26 Aug 2026) is an announcement and was not verified in this round, so not used. Excluded: Idrishpur killing (11 Oct 2026), location not confirmed inside AC; Eastern Yamuna canal post (not opened). Field check recommended: Chhaprauli and Doghat water supply, the Haridwar bus start, the nagar panchayat road proposal dispute, and the cane-payment position at the mills. P5 weak positive: unsourced placeholder (no source found this round), so no delivered benefit is shown.
